name: unicode.utf8
doc:
unicode.utf8: UTF-8 encoding and decoding (Go's unicode/utf8).
Invalid input decodes as (RuneError, 1); surrogates and overlong forms
are invalid. Decoders return (rune, size) tuples:
`var (r, n) = utf8.DecodeRune(b)`.

items.name: RuneError
items.doc: RuneError (U+FFFD) is returned for invalid encodings.
items.summary: RuneError (U+FFFD) is returned for invalid encodings.

items.name: RuneSelf
items.doc: Code points below RuneSelf are a single byte in UTF-8.
items.summary: Code points below RuneSelf are a single byte in UTF-8.

items.name: UTFMax
items.doc: UTFMax is the maximum number of bytes of a UTF-8 encoded code point.
items.summary: UTFMax is the maximum number of bytes of a UTF-8 encoded code point.

items.name: AppendRune
items.doc: Appends the encoding of r (RuneError if r is invalid) to b.
items.summary: Appends the encoding of r (RuneError if r is invalid) to b.

items.name: DecodeLastRune
items.doc: The last rune of b and its size; (RuneError, 0) for empty b.
items.summary: The last rune of b and its size; (RuneError, 0) for empty b.

items.name: DecodeLastRuneInString
items.doc: The last rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".
items.summary: The last rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".

items.name: DecodeRune
items.doc: The first rune of b and its size; (RuneError, 0) for empty b.
items.summary: The first rune of b and its size; (RuneError, 0) for empty b.

items.name: DecodeRuneAt
items.signature: func DecodeRuneAt(s string, i int) (char, int)
items.doc: The rune starting at byte i of s and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).
items.summary: The rune starting at byte i of s and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).

items.name: DecodeRuneIn
items.doc: The rune starting at byte i of b and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).
items.summary: The rune starting at byte i of b and its size ((RuneError, 0) at the end).

items.name: DecodeRuneInString
items.doc: The first rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".
items.summary: The first rune of s and its size; (RuneError, 0) for "".

items.name: EncodeRune
items.doc: The UTF-8 encoding of r (RuneError's if r is invalid).
items.summary: The UTF-8 encoding of r (RuneError's if r is invalid).

items.name: FullRune
items.doc: True if b begins with a complete (possibly invalid) encoding.
items.summary: True if b begins with a complete (possibly invalid) encoding.

items.name: RuneCount
items.doc: Number of runes in b (each invalid byte counts as one).
items.summary: Number of runes in b (each invalid byte counts as one).

items.name: RuneCountInString
items.doc: Number of runes in s (each invalid byte counts as one).
items.summary: Number of runes in s (each invalid byte counts as one).

items.name: RuneLen
items.doc: Bytes needed to encode r, or -1 if r is not a valid code point.
items.summary: Bytes needed to encode r, or -1 if r is not a valid code point.

items.name: RuneStart
items.doc: True if c can start an encoded rune (is not a continuation byte).
items.summary: True if c can start an encoded rune (is not a continuation byte).

items.name: Valid
items.doc: True if b is entirely valid UTF-8.
items.summary: True if b is entirely valid UTF-8.

items.name: ValidRune
items.doc: True if r can be encoded (not a surrogate, at most U+10FFFF).
items.summary: True if r can be encoded (not a surrogate, at most U+10FFFF).

items.name: ValidString
items.doc: True if s is entirely valid UTF-8.
items.summary: True if s is entirely valid UTF-8.
